_doc: Combat engine constants, the one source for both engines (ADR-0001 Implementation Guidelines). Read by tools/design/combat_sim/engine.py and src/gameplay/combat/fight/combat_constants.gd. K: Combat GDD constants (seconds unless named otherwise); U: per-realm unit; SUPP: realm suppression by realm gap (Formulas H); BLOCK_UNIT: block points to health per realm. health_units / qi_units: health_max = health_units x U x n_body x health_mult x d_r and qi_base = qi_units x U x n_qi; cost_red_cap and reserve_cap cap those shares; pay_keep_health: an art paid in health must leave this much; min_hit: a hit that reaches health removes at least this.
